PanelCellsClearing.meaning: cells in the ViT panel clearing the attack success bar

PanelCellsSuccessful.meaning: cells in the ViT panel that are successful backdoors, clearing the attack success bar with clean accuracy within 2 points of the benign model, the population every result spans

PanelCellsSuccessfulFivePoint.meaning: cells in the ViT panel clearing the attack success bar with clean accuracy within 5 points of the benign model

PanelCellsFailingCleanBar.meaning: cells clearing the attack success bar that lose more than 2 points of clean accuracy, excluded from every result

PanelCellsFailingCleanBarFivePoint.meaning: cells clearing the attack success bar that lose more than 5 points of clean accuracy

PanelCellsFailingCleanBarNames.value: SIG at 10\% on CIFAR-10, WaNet at 5\% on CIFAR-10 and WaNet at 10\% on GTSRB
PanelCellsFailingCleanBarNames.meaning: the cells clearing the attack success bar that lose more than 2 points of clean accuracy, as a phrase

PanelCleanBarPoints.meaning: the headline clean-accuracy bar, in points below the benign model

PanelCleanBarPointsSecond.meaning: the second clean-accuracy bar every number is also given at, in points

PanelAttacksSuccessful.meaning: attacks with at least 1 successful cell

PanelCellsTotal.meaning: cells the ViT panel declares, clearing and below the bar together

PanelCellsSourceMapped.meaning: TaCT cells excluded because clean source-class images lose their label

PanelAttacksClearing.meaning: attacks with at least 1 cell clearing the attack success bar
